note: A hand-off for a file that is in no folder a Weir workflow watches.

body.detail: No Weir workflow watches the folder that 'Recorded.Weir.NW.mkv' is in. Weir's workflows: Movies watches 'C:\Downloads\Completed\Movies'; TV Shows (TV episodes) watches 'C:\Downloads\Completed\TV'. Set a workflow's watched folder (Setup › Workflows) to the folder the download client finishes into, or add a path mapping in the media manager.
